# HKCanCor fixture notice

These token annotations were extracted from the Hong Kong Cantonese Corpus
(HKCanCor), created by Luke Kang Kwong. Users should cite K. K. Luke and May
L. Y. Wong (2015), “The Hong Kong Cantonese Corpus: Design and Uses,”
*Journal of Chinese Linguistics Monograph Series* 25, 312–333.

The immutable source revision, archive member, hashes, and extraction procedure
are recorded in `SOURCE.json`. The extracted and normalized fixture is shared
under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; the complete license is
in `LICENSE.txt`. The fixture records, rather than conceals, a known
HKCanCor/ToJyutping annotation difference.
